interface.name: weston_automation_v1
interface.description:
Private protocol for driving a Weston session in automated UI tests: inject seat input and enumerate/control xdg toplevel windows.
The compositor only allows clients running as the same uid as the compositor to bind this global. It must only be enabled on test sessions, never on production desktops.
Input events are injected through a dedicated automation seat that is independent of any physical input devices. Timestamps are generated by the compositor at injection time.

request.name: destroy
request.description: Destroy this object. Toplevel objects created from it remain valid.

request.name: move_pointer

description.summary: move the pointer to an absolute position

request.description: Move the automation seat's pointer to the given position in compositor global coordinates. A pointer_position event follows, reporting the resulting position.

request.name: send_button

description.summary: press or release a pointer button

request.description: Press or release a pointer button on the automation seat. The button code is a Linux evdev code (e.g. BTN_LEFT 0x110).

request.name: send_axis
request.description: Emit a pointer axis (scroll) event on the automation seat.

request.name: send_key
request.description: Press or release a key on the automation seat's keyboard. The key is a Linux evdev keycode (KEY_*), interpreted through the compositor's keymap.

event.name: pointer_position
event.description: Reports the automation pointer position after a move_pointer request has been processed.

event.name: toplevel
event.description: Announces an xdg toplevel window. One event is sent for every toplevel that exists when the client binds, and again whenever a new toplevel appears. The new object's property events follow, terminated by weston_automation_toplevel_v1.done.

interface.name: weston_automation_toplevel_v1
interface.description: Represents one xdg toplevel. Property events (title, app_id, pid, geometry, state) are sent on creation and again whenever a property changes; each batch of updates is terminated by a done event.

request.name: destroy
request.description: Destroy this object. Does not affect the window itself.

request.name: activate
request.description: Give the window keyboard focus on the automation seat and set its activated state. Best-effort: the shell may apply its own policy afterwards.

request.name: close
request.description: Send a close request to the client owning the window (equivalent to xdg_toplevel.close). The client may ignore it.

request.name: set_size
request.description: Request the client to resize its window. The client may respond with a different size; watch geometry events for the result.

request.name: set_position
request.description: Move the window's main view to the given global position. Best-effort: the shell may re-place the window.

event.name: geometry
event.description: Position of the window's main view in global coordinates and the size of its xdg window geometry.

description.summary: end of a property update batch

event.name: closed
event.description: The toplevel is gone. No further events will be sent and all requests except destroy are ignored.
